metadata.article_title: Interest on deposit not allowed to plaintiff after notice.

article.title: Interest on deposit not allowed to plaintiff after notice.
article.content:
3Interest on deposit not allowed to plaintiff after notice.

Order 24, Rule 3
No interest shall be allowed to the plaintiff on any sum deposited by the defendant from the date of the receipt of such notice, whether the sum deposited is in full of the claim or falls short thereof.
